DEED BETWEEN THECITYOFNEWYORK AND NEWYORKCITYLANDDEVELOPMENTCORPORATION Block Lot 1336 31 County: New York RECORDANDRETURNTO: NewYorkCityEconomicDevelopment Corporation OneLibertyPlaza,14thFloor New York, NY 10006 Attention:CarolineNguyen LDCMT-22603

THIS INDENTURE, dated as of the 2nd day of July in the year two thousand twenty six, between THE CITY OF NEW YORK (the “City"), a municipal corporation with an office at City Hall,NewYork,NewYork,hereinafter designated as the Grantor,andNEWYORKCITY LAND DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION ("Grantee" or "LDC"), a not-for-profit corporation incorporated under Section 1411 of the NewYork State Not-for-Profit Corporation Law,with its principal place of business at One Liberty Plaza,NewYork,NewYork,hereinafter designated as theGrantee. WITNESSETH WHEREAS, the Manhattan Borough Board, by resolution adopted on October 20, 1994, approved the transfer of title of the property hereinafter described; and WHEREAS, the Mayor of The City of New York, on January 25, 1995, authorized the sale of such property by the City pursuant to the Mayoral Authorization Cal. No. 6 ; and WHEREAS, at a meeting held on January 20, 1995, the Board of Directors of New York City Economic Development Corporation (*NYCEDC") approved a transaction pursuant to which the City would convey such property for subsequent conveyance to the United Nations Children’s Fund (*"UNICEF") or the United Nations, in furtherance of the City's objective of retaining UNICEF's worldwide headquarters in New York City; and WHEREAS, such transaction contemplated the ultimate conveyance of said property for nominal consideration, subject to the terms and conditions set forth in agreements among the parties; and WHEREAS, in connection with the reorganization of NYCEDC and the establishment of LDC and related entities, the Board of Directors of such successor corporation, at a meeting held on June 21, 2012,authorized the continuation and consummation of acquisitions, dispositions and related transactions previously approved by the Board of Directors of NYCEDC, including the authority to complete such transactions and enter into related agreements to the same extent as NYCEDC was authorized prior to such reorganization; and WHEREAS, this conveyance is made pursuant to Section 384(b)(4) of the New York City Charter and all required governmental approvals obtained thereunder including but not limited to the CPC Resolution Calendar No. 31 dated July 13, 1994; and
